comment:
* Background thread which is destructed after certain period after all pending activities are
 * finished.
 *
 * @deprecated Not being used by any cross library, and should not be used, internal
 * implementation detail.

variables.name: mDestructAfterMillisec
variables.comment: Milliseconds the thread will be destructed after the last activity.

methods.name: public boolean isRunning()
methods.comment: * Returns true if the thread is alive.

methods.name: public void postAndReply(final Callable<T> callable, final ReplyCallback<T> reply)
methods.comment:
* Execute the specific callable object on this thread and call the reply callback on the
     * calling thread once it finishes.

methods.name: public T postAndWait(final Callable<T> callable, int timeoutMillis) throws InterruptedException
methods.comment:
* Execute the specified callable object on this thread and returns the returned value to the
     * caller.
     *
     * If the execution takes longer time than specified timeout duration, this function throws
     * InterruptedException.

methodNames: public void postAndReply(final Callable<T> callable, final ReplyCallback<T> reply)
